newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fresenius denies bonus share talk, shares fall.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius denies bonus share talk, shares fall.

text.p: Shares in German medical group Fresenius AG were down over 2.5 percent in bourse trade on Friday after the group denied media reports that it planned to issue bonus shares.
The group said in a mandatory statement it did not plan to issue bonus shares, nor did it plan any discussion of the matter at its next annual meeting.
Preference shares in Fresenius were down 10 marks at 380 marks, off earlier lows of 374 marks, while the overall DAX index was down 1.10 percent at 3,380.16 points.
